evidence.what: aerial view shows two-way traffic moving on divided road past market stalls
vehicles continue flowing with no stopped vehicles or responders visible

verdict.summary: No incident; busy market road with normal two-way traffic.
verdict.details: Top-down aerial of a divided two-lane road through a market town. Cars, taxis, vans and trucks move steadily both directions. Colorful market umbrellas line both shoulders with crowds beside shops and houses. No crash, stopped vehicle, debris, or emergency vehicles visible. Traffic flow appears normal.
